in_marathi.name: Satyavan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyavan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from 'Satya' meaning 'Truth' and 'Van' meaning 'Forest'. Satyavan was the prince of the forest.

in_bengali.name: Satyavan
in_bengali.long_meaning: Satyavan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from 'Satya' meaning 'Truth' and 'Van' meaning 'Forest'. Satyavan was the prince of the forest.
